title: Type at Cursor
summary: Resolves the static type of the expression under the editor caret
intro: Read this when you are not sure what type an expression has: Type at Cursor resolves the static type of the expression under the editor caret.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Inspect Symbol > Type at Cursor
steps: Put the caret on the expression in the editor
Choose drag-lint > Inspect Symbol > Type at Cursor

questions.ask: What is the static type of the expression under my caret?
